date_inferred_from: Entered at the foot of leaf 343 verso; the next heading of a sitting, on leaf 344, is of 6 September 1781. The heading of its own sitting is on a page not among the scans.

translation.en:
The Illustrious Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, by virtue of [a writ of] diligence — a Manifest is lodged

Let there be seen at this place a Manifest, certain in its substance and [arising from] personal appearance, of the Most Illustrious Magnificent Antoni Ostroróg Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, Knight of the Order of Saint Stanislaus, Heir of the estates of Trąbczyn, Trąbczynka, Nowa Wieś, and others — in and against the Illustrious Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, Heir of the estates of Łukomia, Łomowa, and others — as the copy in the submitted documents [attests].

Upon the manifest: Antoni Ostroróg of Kolno Prusimski [illegible]

summary_en: A register note of a protest, 1781: Antoni Ostroróg Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice, knight of the Order of St Stanislaus, heir of Trąbczyn, Trąbczynek and Nowa Wieś, appeared in person and protests, as a precaution, against Stanisław Chełmski, Treasurer of Wschowa, heir of Łukomia and Łomów; a copy is among the documents produced. Prusimski signed.
summary_de: Registervermerk über einen Protest, 1781: Antoni Ostroróg Prusimski, Starost von Niszczewice, Ritter des St.-Stanislaus-Ordens, Erbherr von Trąbczyn, Trąbczynek und Nowa Wieś, ist persönlich erschienen und protestiert vorsorglich gegen Stanisław Chełmski, Schatzmeister von Wschowa, Erbherr von Łukomia und Łomów; eine Abschrift liegt bei den vorgelegten Schriftstücken. Prusimski hat unterschrieben.
